availability_plus_seven_days.eligibility: baseline or shifted card day contains at least one newly available event
availability_plus_seven_days.transform: add exactly seven calendar days to every available_at under each archive schedule and rebuild every card

dependency_edge_direction_reverse.eligibility: card contains at least one ADDED or REMOVED dependency delta

old_new_direction_reverse.eligibility: card contains at least one source event
old_new_direction_reverse.transform: swap all old/new derived fields and exact side paths; map CREATE<->DELETE and retain UPDATE; swap explicit metadata states; reverse D5 normalized text-delta ADD/REMOVE rows before canonical D6 rechunking; retain administrative quarantine as model-hidden

proposal_version_pair_cyclic_permutation.eligibility: card contains an UPDATE from a protocol/source_year stratum with at least two eligible UPDATE events
proposal_version_pair_cyclic_permutation.transform: within each protocol/source_year, sort eligible UPDATE events by event_id and rotate old-blob-derived fields forward by one while holding new-blob-derived fields fixed

protocol_label_swap.eligibility: decision day has at least one non-sentinel event or counterpart
protocol_label_swap.transform: swap ethereum<->bitcoin labels after extraction; preserve raw event identity, exact side-path audit hash, metadata state, and underlying D5 normalized text-delta rows; rebuild canonical D6 chunks and relation cards; administrative quarantine remains model-hidden

section_label_cyclic_rotation.eligibility: card contains at least one changed section other than OTHER
section_label_cyclic_rotation.transform: rotate changed-section labels over ABSTRACT,MOTIVATION,SPECIFICATION,RATIONALE,BACKWARD_COMPATIBILITY,SECURITY,TESTS,IMPLEMENTATION,COPYRIGHT; keep OTHER fixed

within_day_event_order_reverse.eligibility: either protocol has at least two newly available events that day
within_day_event_order_reverse.transform: reverse each protocol/day canonical event sequence before pairing; preserve event payloads
